page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: "Cap.84." left and "AVGVSTINVS" right. Above the chapter: continuation of text in full lines. Then a woodcut headline ornament, a large title "HAERESES AB IPSO Augustino additæ.", a centred chapter heading "CAP. LXXXIIII.", and a centred italic summary in two lines. Then the body text with a large woodcut initial "I" (AM). Below the text, no notes. No margin notes.

main_text.p: inducat. Tanti est nimirum vanis animi sui speculationibus indulgere, aut sese vitiis, lasciuiaque dedere, quod vtrique & Arabici, & Psychopannychitæ (aduersus quos eruditissimè piæ memoriæ D. Caluinus scripsit) fecerunt.
main_text.head: HAERESES AB IPSO Augustino additæ.
CAP. LXXXIIII.

p.i: Aliæ hæreses, è quibus prima est Heluidianorum, & quod illius dogma fuerit.

main_text.p: IAM nunc illæ commemorandæ sunt hæreses, quæ à nobis non apud istos reperta sunt, sed in recordationem nostram quomodocunque venerunt. Heluidiani exorti ab Heluidio ita virginitati Mariæ contradicunt, vt eam post Christum alios etiam filios de viro suo Ioseph peperisse contendant: sed mirum ni istos, prætermisso Heluidij nomine, Antidicomaritas Epiphanius appellat.
1 Heluidiani exorti.) Transitio est. Iam enim præter eas hæreses, quas tum ex Eusebij & Epiphanij libris, tum etiam Philastri commentario decerpsit, descripsitque Augustinus, alias affert

page.notes: The initial letter is a large woodcut "I" (for "Iam"), joined to "AM" as printed; read as IAM. The first word "Iam" is printed "AM" after the initial; rendered as printed with initial. The marginal reference "1" and "Heluidiani exorti." are printed in the text block as a sidenote-like marker; the "1" is a section number at line start, transcribed as printed. The ornament above the chapter heading is a woodcut, not transcribed. The last line "affert" is set flush right and is a catchword-like continuation; it is kept as the final line of text. Lines with long s rendered as s. Possible misreading: "Antidicomaritas" as printed.
